subject: SOC 2: supplemental VM incident closure & exception reconciliation
messages:
From: DevSecOps - Acme Payments <devsecops@acme-payments.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up: SOC 2 evidence — VM incident details requested

Hi Olga / Laura,

Thanks for the quick responses earlier this week. Acme is triaging a late-disclosed (from our SIG intake) vulnerability that was observed in our integration logs on 2028-11-22. Our SOC 2 auditor has asked for supplemental evidence specifically tied to the incident: full scan exports covering 11/20–11/30, per-CVE closure statuses with dates and owners, and any evidence of compensating controls or exception approvals that were in place at the time.

Specifically we need:
- Combined scanner export (raw XML/JSON or PDF summary) for the window 2028-11-20 through 2028-11-30.
- A CSV or table showing CVE IDs, severity, status (open/in-progress/closed), fix ETA and actual close date if closed, and the remediation owner.
- Any forensic summary or root-cause notes for the 11/22 discovery (who discovered, what triggered it).
- If there were SLA exceptions or temporary mitigations used, the ticket/approval and date ranges.

Can you provide these items by EOD Monday 12/04? If there are controls that we can reference in our SOC 2 package (e.g., automatic prefix/KV cache isolation, deployment pinning that limited blast radius), please include short descriptions and links to evidence.

Appreciate it — our auditor is on a tight schedule.

Thanks,
Maya Iyer
DevSecOps, Acme Payments
security@acme-payments.com

(attachment: none)

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: DevSecOps - Acme Payments <devsecops@acme-payments.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 01 Dec 2028 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 evidence — VM incident details requested

Maya — thanks for the clear list. We reviewed the incident internally and are compiling a supplemental packet. Initial items attached below and summarized:

Attachments included
- scan_export_20281130.pdf (consolidated scanner summary for 11/20–11/30)
- cve_timeline_20281122-20281201.csv (per-CVE status & dates)
- forensic_summary_20281124.txt (short root-cause notes from the on-call postmortem)

Summary (quick):
- Incident discovered 2028-11-22 by our internal runtime monitor (automated anomaly in token prefix handling). No data exfiltration identified.
- We re-ran VM scans on 11/24 and 11/30 with the same toolchain; export attached.
- CVE tracking: we have five items that were in the scanner window. Two were closed on 2028-11-27 (backported patch + release), two are scheduled and assigned (owner/ETA in CSV), one is an accepted exception documented in internal ticket SEC-4721 — compensating control: network egress rule added and temporary WAF rule deployed on 2028-11-23.
- We are providing a signed attestation for the exception lane; DocuSign route pending (link included once signed).

Next steps we are taking internally:
- Ben / Priyom are finalizing the patch plan and will provide a mapping to the SLAs called out in your questionnaire (target: confirm closure within our 30/90 day remediation commitments or provide documented exception).
- We will provide a short note that your auditor can include in the SOC 2 pack describing the compensating controls and the monitoring alerts that detected the anomaly.

Ben / Priyom / Laura — looping you for confirmation of the dates and the patch spreadsheet (please attach patch_plan_20281202.xlsx in your reply).

Olga Petrov
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference
(attachment: scan_export_20281130.pdf, cve_timeline_20281122-20281201.csv, forensic_summary_20281124.txt)

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 02 Dec 2028 10:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 evidence — VM incident details requested

All — quick coordination note and commitments.

I dug into the two items that were closed on 11/27 and confirmed the backports and release notes. I have attached the patch_plan_20281202.xlsx for mapping to owners and SLAs. High level:
- CVE-2028-4123 (critical): backported and released 2028-11-27 by release team (owner: eng-release@redwood.com). Post-deploy validation run completed 11/28.
- CVE-2028-4199 (high): mitigated via configuration change 11/23 (WAF rule), full patch scheduled 12/05 (owner: pri-arch).
- CVE-2028-4208 (medium): scheduled for 30-day window, assigned to Priyom Das (ETA 2028-12-20).
- CVE-2028-4101 (low): accepted exception; compensating control is network egress rule and application-level input validation; exception request approved 2028-11-24 under SEC-4721.

Priyom — can you confirm the planned remediation steps for 4208 and share the confirmation once the change hits staging? We will link CI validation logs back to the CSV.

Ben
Sr. Vulnerability Ops, Redwood
(attachment: patch_plan_20281202.xlsx)

> > Maya — thanks for the clear list...

From: DevSecOps - Acme Payments <devsecops@acme-payments.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 03 Dec 2028 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SOC 2 evidence — VM incident details requested

Olga — thanks, this packet looks good and aligns with what our auditor asked for. A couple of small asks before we close the request:

- Please include (or confirm) the DocuSign attestation for the accepted exception (SEC-4721) when available.
- If possible, add CI validation run IDs for the two closed CVEs (we can reference logs rather than full artifacts).

We can accept the PDF/CSV/short forensic note for the SOC 2 pack — once DocuSign arrives we'll mark the exception as documented.

If you prefer, we can pull the attestation link into our audit portal; otherwise send the signed DocuSign link to this thread and we'll attach.

Thanks for the quick turnaround.

—Maya
DevSecOps, Acme Payments
(attachment: none)
